Milestone — `base-conscious-astarte` implementation pushed.

- Commit `9726a439fb86e3b3bb2cc0ca2ef209794fb5cd9c` changes only the 22 allowlisted comment/docstring blocks across the four owned test modules (44 insertions, 146 deletions).
- Structural proof passed: normalized ASTs, all outside-block bytes, and all non-allowlisted comments are unchanged; all 22 edited blocks are shorter.
- Scoped validation passed: 71 focused tests in 142.59s, Ruff check, Ruff format check, comment hygiene, and path-scoped diff check.
- The commit hook passed repository lint and typecheck with the worktree venv; commit-ticket verification resolved `89eb-b9dc-6f1b-4b4c`.
- Independent reviewer audited immutable blobs `08033c6ae93126110c35cb936a58ce3145e77eb2` → `9726a439fb86e3b3bb2cc0ca2ef209794fb5cd9c` and posted the required 22-row TSV PASS receipt on the leaf.
- Gerrit change: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2745
- Per operator direction, full local `make verify` was not run; Gerrit CI is the full-suite authority for this documentation-only change.
